sentiment.rationale: The company reported a modest 0.6% comparable sales increase and a 3.8% adjusted EPS gain versus the prior year, but full-year guidance was reaffirmed unchanged (sales $92B-$94B, comps flat to +2%, adjusted EPS $12.25-$12.75). Management explicitly noted that DIY demand remains under pressure and that the broader market is expected to remain flat in 2026. The Q2 outlook calls for adjusted EPS approximately 2% below prior year. The backward-looking beat is offset by flat forward guidance and cautious language, resulting in a neutral score.

summary.revenue: $23.1 billion, up 10.3% from Q1 last year; comparable sales increased 0.6%.
summary.eps: GAAP diluted EPS of $2.90; adjusted diluted EPS of $3.03, up 3.8% versus prior year ($2.92).
summary.guidance: Fiscal 2026 outlook affirmed: sales $92B-$94B, comparable sales flat to +2%, adjusted operating margin 11.6%-11.8%, adjusted diluted EPS approximately $12.25-$12.75. Q2 comp sales expected roughly in line with the midpoint of the full-year guide; Q2 adjusted diluted EPS expected approximately 2% below prior year.
summary.margin: Gross margin 32.7%, down 70 bps; SG&A 19.2% of sales, leveraging 17 bps; adjusted operating margin 11.5%, down 43 bps versus prior year.
key_risks: Elevated interest rates, higher costs, and low housing turnover.
Near-term pressure from higher transportation costs.
Tariff environment and renewed inflation (fuel, resin, plastics).
Challenging residential construction market impacting FBM and ADG.
Pro customers have concerns about growing labor costs.
key_opportunities: Continued strength in Pro, Appliances, Online (15.5% growth), and Home Services.
MyLowe's Pro Rewards loyalty program resonating with small to medium Pro customers.
Mylow AI shopping assistant driving triple the conversion rate for users.
HomeCare+ subscription service to build long-term DIY customer relationships.
FBM and ADG acquisitions positioning for future homebuilding recovery.
Rollout of workwear and pet assortments to all stores by year-end.
Pro Extended Aisle initiative driving Pro sales.
Potential tailwinds from tax refunds and HELOC activity.

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: Management expresses confidence in execution and market share gains ('we're pleased with our performance,' 'we're well positioned') but also acknowledges persistent headwinds ('DIY demand remains under pressure,' 'the most difficult housing market since the financial crisis') and reaffirms unchanged guidance with cautious forward language.

evidence.claim: Revenue was $23.1 billion, up 10.3% from Q1 last year.
evidence.quote: Sales for the first quarter were $23.1 billion, up 10.3% from Q1 last year, in line with expectations.
Comparable sales were up 0.6% driven by well-coordinated spring execution, including our SpringFest event, along with continued strength in Pro, Appliances, Online and Home Services.

evidence.claim: Adjusted diluted EPS was $3.03, up 3.8% versus prior year.
evidence.quote: we delivered adjusted diluted earnings per share of $3.03, up 3.8% versus the prior year.

today, we are affirming our fiscal 2026 outlook. We continue to expect sales in the range of $92 billion to $94 billion, with comparable sales in a range of flat to up 2%. We expect adjusted operating margin in a range of 11.6% to 11.8% and full-year adjusted diluted earnings per share of approximately $12.25 to $12.75.

evidence.claim: Q2 adjusted diluted EPS expected approximately 2% below prior year.
evidence.quote: we expect adjusted diluted earnings per share in the second quarter to be approximately 2% below prior year adjusted diluted earnings per share.

evidence.claim: Gross margin was 32.7%, down 70 basis points.
evidence.quote: For the first quarter, gross margin was 32.7%, down 70 basis points and in line with our expectations, primarily driven by the dilutive impact of FBM and ADG, offset by favorability in credit revenue.

evidence.claim: SG&A was 19.2% of sales, leveraging 17 basis points.
evidence.quote: SG&A was 19.2% of sales, leveraging 17 basis points from continued disciplined cost management and the accretive impact of FBM and ADG.

evidence.claim: Adjusted operating margin was 11.5%, down 43 basis points.
evidence.quote: Adjusted operating margin rate of 11.5% was down 43 basis points versus prior year, also in line with our expectations.
While DIY demand remains under pressure, we're continuing to grow market share in a challenging housing environment shaped by elevated interest rates, higher cost, and low housing turnover.

evidence.claim: Near-term pressure from higher transportation costs.
evidence.quote: near-term pressure from higher transportation costs that we are actively working to offset through productivity initiatives in the back half of the year.

evidence.claim: Tariff environment and renewed inflation are risks.
evidence.quote: We are seeing a pretty immediate impact from the oil prices. It's pressuring fuel, commodity-based products like resin and plastics. ... We're managing the tariff situation with the IEEPA ruling, new section 122, 232 tariff actions that we're working through and how that impacts the business, in particular, in the second half of the year.
We delivered sales growth of 15.5% this quarter driven by continued enhancements to our user experience, standout online deals and improved fulfillment capabilities, including same-day delivery.

evidence.claim: Mylow AI assistant drives triple the conversion rate for users.
evidence.quote: the conversion rate for online customers who use Mylow is triple that of customers who do not use the tool, suggesting a well-designed agentic AI experience can be a clear driver in the purchasing decision.

We're pleased with our performance this quarter despite February storms... While DIY demand remains under pressure... we're continuing to grow market share in a challenging housing environment... we expect the broader market to remain flat in 2026.
